lines.text: All who speak in proverbs will say 'Like mother, like daughter,' because Jerusalem's mother was a Hittite and her father an Amorite.
Samaria lived to Jerusalem's south and Sodom to her north, and Jerusalem soon became more depraved than both.

wrong_details.wrong: Samaria lived to the south and Sodom to the north
wrong_details.true: Samaria lived to the north and Sodom to the south

lines.text: Sodom was arrogant, overfed and complacent and did not help the poor, yet Samaria did not commit half of Jerusalem's sins.
God will restore Sodom and Samaria but not Jerusalem, who is now scorned by the daughters of Edom and the Philistines.

wrong_details.wrong: God will restore Sodom and Samaria but not Jerusalem
wrong_details.true: God will restore Sodom and Samaria and Jerusalem along with them

lines.text: Jerusalem broke the covenant, yet God will remember it, establish an everlasting covenant, and make atonement for all she has done.
